news_items.headline: Dodgers tie Braves record with 14 postseasons in a row. Stan Kasten was there for both
news_items.summary: The Dodgers with their win over the Cincinnati Reds on Monday night at Great American Ball Park are back in the postseason, just as they have every year dating back to 2013. They tied a major league record by making 14 postseasons in a row. That’s every full season of Guggenheim Baseball Management owning the […]
